text:
sara-partnerships: Quick preflight for AWS/GCP/Azure listing. Scope: publisher IDs, KMS for private offers, SKU names, and legal copy. Who can own what?

michael-legal: I can draft the KMS consent + short EULA blurb. Need to confirm if prompts are logged by default.

anya-eng: We don't persist raw prompts by default; aggregated metrics only. I'll produce a minimal manifest example and IAM checklist.

tom-ops: For private offers we require customer KMS ARN and a cross-account key policy. Also need support_email in manifest or validator fails.

anya-eng: Tiny manifest snippet (placeholders): {"offer":"redwood-inference","skus":[{"id":"rdi-standard","trial_days":14}],"regions":["us-west-2","europe-west1"],"support_email":"support@redwood.ai"}

marketplace-bot: Validator reminder: logo must be >=1024x1024 and support_email required. Failures posted here.

sara-partnerships: Actions: michael-legal -> KMS consent + EULA (Tue EOD); anya-eng -> full manifest + IAM checklist (Mon); tom-ops -> KMS policy + terraform snippet (Mon). Sync Wed 10am PT to review before sandbox upload.

michael-legal: I'll add residency opt-out language for EU and note support-debug opt-in for logs.

anya-eng: I'll upload artifacts to the shared drive and link here when ready.

sara-partnerships: Thanks all 680. If any hardware/SI partners want to join pilot, reply here and I'll loop them in.
